name: Lily Hop Relay
promptTemplate: A frantic multiplayer frog race across {{pond_theme}} water with {{pad_count}} pads, sinking to {{hazard_style}} at {{rhythm_speed}} speed, enhanced by {{water_ripples}}.

ui.title: LILY HOP RELAY +5
ui.tagline: LEAP ACROSS THE POND BEFORE THE PADS DUNK YOU

hop.hint: Mash to leap to the next lily pad

pad_count.hint: Changes the number of hops to reach the finish bank

pond_theme.hint: Cycles background water and pad colors

hazard_style.hint: Swaps how lily pads rise and sink

listing.blurb: Frogs race across a pond on sinking lily pads, leaping forward to the rhythm or splashing back to the starting bank.
listing.prompt: A frog race across a pond, a frog in every person's colour: press 'hop' to jump to the next lily pad, but the pads sink and resurface in a rhythm, and landing on a sunken pad dunks you back to the bank with a splash; the first frog across wins. Make it a party game a whole room can follow from across the floor: bold shapes and bright colours on a dark ground, every player drawn in their own hue, big short labels (a score, GO!, the winner) in a heavy font, and a large, satisfying reaction on screen the instant anyone presses. It must work with one player or forty, scaling its lanes, seats or pieces to room.people and coping with people joining and leaving mid-round; play itself in a lively attract mode whenever nobody has pressed anything for a few seconds; and after a winner is shown, start the next round on its own. Keep it lean: game state in bounded arrays in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080.
